questions.question: What best describes what a computer does with information?
options: It takes in data, processes it, and gives out results
questions.explanation: A computer accepts input data, processes it, and produces output, which is its basic job.

questions.question: What is an input device used for?
options: Sending information out of the computer
questions.explanation: An input device is used to put data and commands into the computer.

questions.question: What does a single left click of the mouse usually do to an item?
questions.explanation: A single left click normally selects an item on the screen.

questions.question: What is the main job of an operating system on a computer?
options: To type documents for you automatically
To connect two computers with a cable
To manage the hardware and let you run programs
To make the screen brighter only
questions.explanation: An operating system manages the computer's hardware and provides a way to run software programs.

questions.question: What does uninstalling a program do?
options: It removes the program from your computer
It makes the program open faster
It prints the program on paper
It sends the program to a friend
questions.explanation: Uninstalling removes a program and its files from the computer.

questions.question: When you delete a file in Windows, where does it usually go first?
questions.explanation: Deleted files normally go to the Recycle Bin first, so they can be restored if needed.

questions.question: What is a web browser?
options: A program used to open and view websites
A cable that connects to the wall
A folder where photos are saved
questions.explanation: A web browser is the software you use to open and view websites on the internet.

questions.question: Which of these is a smart internet safety habit?
options: Sharing your password with strangers online
Keeping personal details like your password private
Using the same simple password everywhere
questions.explanation: Keeping personal details such as passwords private is a basic and important safety habit.

questions.question: What is the safest place to download apps to your phone?
options: An official app store like Google Play
Any link sent by a stranger
A shared USB from someone you do not know
questions.explanation: Official app stores check apps for safety, so they are much safer than random links or pop-ups.

questions.question: What does the Reply button do?
options: Sends a response back to the sender
questions.explanation: Reply lets you write back to the person who sent you the email.

questions.question: Which key removes the character just to the left of the cursor?
questions.explanation: The Backspace key deletes the character before the cursor.

questions.question: What are the margins of a page?
options: The blank space around the edges of the text
questions.explanation: Margins are the empty borders between the text and the paper edges.

questions.question: What is the difference between a workbook and a worksheet?
options: A workbook is the whole file; a worksheet is one page inside it
They are exactly the same thing
A workbook can hold only one worksheet
questions.explanation: A workbook is the entire Excel file, and it can contain many worksheets (tabs).

questions.question: What does sorting data in Excel do?
options: Arranges rows in a chosen order, such as A to Z
questions.explanation: Sorting rearranges rows into an order like alphabetical or smallest to largest.

questions.question: When you start a new PowerPoint file, what does the first slide usually contain?
questions.explanation: New presentations open with a title slide that has placeholders for a title and subtitle.

questions.question: Which Ribbon tab is used to insert audio or video into a slide?
questions.explanation: Audio and Video buttons are found in the Media group on the Insert tab.

questions.question: What do you usually click to share a file in Google Drive?
questions.explanation: The Share button lets you give other people access to your file or folder.

questions.question: Which option starts a brand new Google Meet meeting?
questions.explanation: Clicking New meeting lets you start a new Google Meet call.

questions.question: Why is it a good idea to gently clean dust out of your computer's vents and fan openings?
options: It stops the computer from overheating
questions.explanation: Dust blocks airflow, so cleaning the vents helps the computer stay cool and avoid overheating.

questions.question: What should you do before cleaning the inside or hardware of a computer?
options: Turn it off and unplug it from power
questions.explanation: Shutting down and unplugging prevents electric shock and damage while you clean.
